name: Azure DevOps
desc: Track work, code, and ship software with Azure Boards, Repos, and Pipelines.

actions.name: create_work_item
actions.description: Creates a new work item (Bug, Task, User Story, etc.) in Azure DevOps

actions.name: get_work_item
actions.description: Retrieves a work item by ID from Azure DevOps

actions.name: update_work_item
actions.description: Updates an existing work item in Azure DevOps

actions.name: list_work_items
actions.description: Lists work items from Azure DevOps using a WIQL query

actions.name: add_comment
actions.description: Adds a comment to an existing work item in Azure DevOps

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: new_updated_work_item_webhook
triggers.description: Fires instantly when a work item is created, updated, or commented on in Azure DevOps via a Service Hooks subscription. Requires a public webhook URL reachable from Azure DevOps.

triggers.name: new_updated_work_item
triggers.description: Polls Azure DevOps every few minutes and fires when a work item is created or updated. Use this when your Activepieces instance is not reachable from the public internet; otherwise prefer the Instant trigger. Pick a work item type to unlock the state filter.
